selection.ownership: ContactOut Limited operating the international contactout.com product from 934 Howard St, San Francisco, CA 94103, United States. Not a mainland-China edition.

research.searchCoverage: Bounded 2026-09-13 review of official ContactOut API (host https://api.contactout.com, token plus authorization: basic, GET /v1/stats, contact checkers that do not consume credits, People Search billed separately), ContactOut Limited San Francisco identity, privacy/GDPR pages, and dated incident search. Trustpilot/BBB complaints about data-broker listings are not a confirmed platform security breach. No qualifying current unresolved ContactOut compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

incidents.finding: Bounded search of ContactOut / ContactOut Limited security breach and incident coverage on 2026-09-13 identified no current unresolved customer-credential compromise. Public GDPR/opt-out complaints about data-broker listings were distinguished from a platform breach.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified.

research.searchCoverage: Official ContactOut API documents HTTPS host https://api.contactout.com, token header plus authorization: basic, GET /v1/stats with optional period, and LinkedIn contact checkers that do not consume credits. People Search is separately billed and is not used as healthcheck. Operator is ContactOut Limited with a San Francisco office at 934 Howard St. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying current unresolved ContactOut platform compromise.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

campaigns.get.description: Return one campaign's sequence steps and optionally its performance statistics.
campaigns.get.title: Get campaign

campaigns.list.description: Return one page of email campaigns and their lifecycle statuses.
campaigns.list.title: List campaigns

campaigns.recipients.add.description: Add 1-100 recipients to an existing campaign. A successful request can still contain failed recipients.
campaigns.recipients.add.title: Add campaign recipients

campaigns.recipients.remove.description: Destructively remove 1-100 recipients from an existing campaign by email.
campaigns.recipients.remove.title: Remove campaign recipients

campaigns.start.description: Start a draft ContactOut campaign or resume a stopped campaign.
campaigns.start.title: Start campaign

campaigns.stop.description: Stop a running ContactOut campaign, interrupting its outreach.
campaigns.stop.title: Stop campaign

companies.domain.enrich.description: Return company profiles for 1-30 domains. Each found company consumes a search credit.
companies.domain.enrich.title: Enrich companies by domain

companies.search.description: Return one page of companies matching identity, size, location, industry, technology, revenue, or founding-year filters.
companies.search.title: Search companies

email.enrich.description: Return a professional profile matched from an email address, optionally requesting real-time work-email verification.
email.enrich.title: Enrich person by email

email.verify.description: Check one email address for valid, invalid, accept-all, disposable, or unknown deliverability.
email.verify.title: Verify email

email.verify.batch.create.description: Queue asynchronous deliverability verification for 1-100 email addresses, optionally delivering results to a callback URL.
email.verify.batch.create.title: Create bulk email verification job

email.verify.batch.get.description: Get the status and available per-email results of an asynchronous bulk email-verification job.
email.verify.batch.get.title: Get bulk email verification job

healthcheck.description: Validate the ContactOut API token with GET /v1/stats.
healthcheck.title: Healthcheck

linkedin.enrich.description: Return a professional profile for a regular LinkedIn profile URL, optionally including contact data.
linkedin.enrich.title: Enrich LinkedIn profile

people.count.description: Estimate matching people and available personal emails, work emails, and phones from People Search filters without consuming credits.
people.count.title: Count people

people.decision-makers.description: Return one page of key decision makers for the best-matching company identified by LinkedIn URL, domain, or name.
people.decision-makers.title: List decision makers

people.enrich.description: Find and enrich one person using a LinkedIn URL, email, or phone; alternatively provide a name plus employer, education, location, or job-title evidence.
people.enrich.title: Enrich person

people.identifiers.description: Return unordered SHA-256 hashes of normalized personal emails found for 5-100 distinct LinkedIn profiles.
people.identifiers.title: Get hashed email identifiers

people.linkedin.batch.description: Synchronously reveal contact information for 1-100 LinkedIn profiles.
people.linkedin.batch.title: Get LinkedIn contact info batch

people.linkedin.batch.create.description: Queue asynchronous contact discovery for 1-1000 LinkedIn profiles, optionally delivering results to a callback URL.
people.linkedin.batch.create.title: Create LinkedIn contact info batch job

people.linkedin.batch.job.get.description: Get the status and available results of an asynchronous LinkedIn contact-info batch job.
people.linkedin.batch.job.get.title: Get LinkedIn contact info batch job

people.linkedin.contact-availability.description: Check whether a LinkedIn profile has a personal email, work email, or phone without revealing it or consuming credits.
people.linkedin.contact-availability.title: Check LinkedIn contact availability

people.linkedin.get.description: Reveal email and optionally phone contact information for one regular LinkedIn profile URL.
people.linkedin.get.title: Get LinkedIn contact info

people.linkedin.personal-email-status.description: Check whether ContactOut has a personal email for a LinkedIn profile.
people.linkedin.personal-email-status.title: Check personal email availability

people.linkedin.phone-status.description: Check whether ContactOut has a phone number for a LinkedIn profile.
people.linkedin.phone-status.title: Check phone availability

people.linkedin.work-email-status.description: Check whether ContactOut has a work email for a LinkedIn profile.
people.linkedin.work-email-status.title: Check work email availability

people.person.get.description: Resolve an email address to its matching LinkedIn profile URL.
people.person.get.title: Find LinkedIn profile by email

people.search.description: Return one page of professional profiles matching person, role, employer, education, location, and contact-availability filters.
people.search.title: Search people

stats.get.description: Read ContactOut API usage statistics for an optional YYYY-MM period.
stats.get.title: Get usage stats
